camel_example: aliyun iot RRpc --region cn-hangzhou --Timeout 1000 --ProductKey aldfeSe0000 --RequestBase64Byte dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl --DeviceName device1
description_en: Sends a request message to a specified device and synchronously returns the response
description_zh: 向指定设备发送请求消息，并同步返回响应
kebab_example: aliyun iot rrpc --product-key aldfeSe0000 --device-name device1 --timeout 1000 --request-base64-byte dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RRpc

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this ID value is available, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the message is sent
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The device name of the device that receives the message
parameters.help_zh: 要接收消息的设备名称
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for waiting for the device response. Unit: milliseconds. Valid values: 1000 to 8000
parameters.help_zh: 等待设备回复消息的时间，单位是毫秒，取值范围是1,000 ~8,000
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
The type of message that the server sends to the specified device when the JT/T 808 protocol is used. Valid values:

0: detailed positioning data of the GNSS module.
11: IC card information of the road transport certificate.
65: serial port 1 pass-through.
66: serial port 2 pass-through.
240 to 255: user-defined pass-through.

For more information about the JT/T 808 protocol supported by IoT Platform, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/474256.html
parameters.help_zh:
使用JT/T 808协议通信时，服务端向指定设备发送消息的类型。可取值：

0：GNSS模块详细定位数据。
11：道路运输证IC卡信息。
65：串口1透传。
66：串口2透传。
240~255：用户自定义透传。

物联网平台支持的JT/T 808协议详细使用说明，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/474256.html
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded string of the message content to be sent, for example, `dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl`
parameters.help_zh: 要发送的消息内容经过Base64编码得到的字符串格式数据，例如`dGhpcyBpcyBhbiBleGFtcGxl`
parameters.name: request_base64_byte

parameters.help_en:
The custom RRPC-related topic. The device must be developed accordingly. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90570.html in device development.
If you do not specify this parameter, the default system RRPC topic is used
parameters.help_zh:
使用自定义的RRPC相关Topic。需要设备端配合使用，请参见设备端开发https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/90570.html。
不传入此参数，则使用系统默认的RRPC Topic
parameters.name: topic

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

MessageId.description_en: The message ID generated by the cloud after the request message is sent. This ID identifies the message
MessageId.description_zh: 成功发送请求消息后，云端生成的消息ID，用于标识该消息

PayloadBase64Byte.description_en: The Base64-encoded value of the result returned by the device
PayloadBase64Byte.description_zh: 设备返回结果Base64编码后的值

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

RrpcCode.description_en:
The return code generated if the call is successful. This code indicates the request status. Valid values:
UNKNOWN: A system exception occurred.
SUCCESS: The request is successful.
TIMEOUT: The device response timed out.
OFFLINE: The device is offline.
HALFCONN: The device is offline. The device connection is disconnected, but the disconnection time does not exceed one heartbeat cycle
RrpcCode.description_zh:
调用成功时，生成的调用返回码，标识请求状态。取值：
UNKNOWN：系统异常。
SUCCESS：成功 。
TIMEOUT：设备响应超时。
OFFLINE：设备离线。
HALFCONN：设备离线（设备连接断开，但是断开时间未超过一个心跳周期）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call is successful.
true: The call is successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
